name: lorisse
description: A memory that is yours, in plain files. Reads your memory folder (where, open, search, read, links) and, when you ask, files a memory, a note or a link as one commit you can undo (remember, note, link, undo).

memory_folder.title: Memory folder
memory_folder.description: The folder that holds your memory, used when the session is opened somewhere else. A session opened on a memory folder uses that folder.
